description:
Find variable ids in the ICOS catalogue by name, quantity or unit.
    The ids are what estimate and get_data take.  Primary measurements come
    before their companions (standard deviation, value counts, flags).

limit.description: the most variables to return, best first
limit.title: Limit

store.description: limit to one store, e.g. icos-obspack.zarr
store.title: Store

text.description: what to look for: a gas, a quantity or a name, e.g. 'co2', 'methane', 'net ecosystem exchange', 'fCO2'
text.title: Text

name: search_variables

access.description: query: estimate/get_data/aggregate serve it; zarr: a multi-dimensional variable (e.g. the ONEFlux NEE cube) read with xarray -- see zarr_recipe, and `prescribed` for its /query slice
access.title: Access

axes.description: zarr variables: each extra axis and its labels
axes.title: Axes

cf_standard_name.description: the CF standard name, given only for an exact match
cf_standard_name.title: Cf Standard Name

ecv.description: the GCOS Essential Climate Variable this observation contributes to; ICOS provides the observation, not the ECV product
ecv.title: Ecv

ecv_relation.description: 'related' when the variable is outside the ECV's own variable set (NEE to the greenhouse-gas ECV)
ecv_relation.title: Ecv Relation

ecv_role.description: observation, or derived and how (gap-filled, partitioned, aggregated)
ecv_role.title: Ecv Role

prescribed.description: zarr variables: the id of the preferred slice /query serves
prescribed.title: Prescribed

query_kind.description: station_time (series at stations), obs_table (ship/cruise observations) or grid (gridded product)
query_kind.title: Query Kind
